_what_this_is: For each CAPABILITY the project needs, which implementation is AUTHORITATIVE and which are deprecated. Declared, not inferred.
_why: s099, after JP said it three times: 'es un tema de arquitectura... nuevamente'. The recurring failure was never 'we forgot to wire X'. It is that seven layers exist (CLI graph_queries, MCP server, quality_checks, algorithms, agents, skills, hooks) and NOTHING declared which layer owns a given need. So the same capability got built twice, in two layers, reading two different sources, and both rotted. Measured examples are below: two brain-search implementations reading DIFFERENT files, and two ABAP write paths one of which bypasses the entire INC-CLASS-LOSS remediation.
_rule: One capability, one owner. A second implementation is either DEPRECATED with a pointer to the owner, or it is a defect. capability_ownership_check.py enforces it.

deprecated.why: A DIFFERENT source. It cannot see the entity index, the companion graph, OPEN WORK or WHAT WE KNOW DEEPLY - everything s099 added. Two answers to the same question with nothing saying which is right is worse than one incomplete answer.

must_enforce: returns provenance + freshness with every read (feedback_gold_db_is_p01_provenance)
one place to get a table name wrong instead of fifteen

deprecated.why: What s099 actually did - roughly 15 one-off snippets, several with real bugs (a wrong table name, a broken escape, an operator-precedence slip). Each bypassed the provenance and freshness the project's own rules require.
The right design in a layer that never ran. Port the contract, not the code.

write_abap_to_d01.gates: own-objects manifest + TADIR/SEOCLASS pre-flight + PRE readback + hard diff-gate (HALT on deletions) + W-5 operator guard + concurrent-writer guard + POST readback byte-verify

deprecated.why: lock -> write -> syntax -> activate, with NO manifest check, NO PRE/POST readback and NO diff-gate. It bypasses the entire remediation built after INC-CLASS-LOSS (2026-06-12), where a session corrupted real N_MENARD classes by writing in place. The ALLOW_D01_WRITES kill-switch in the ADT clients currently blocks it, but a kill-switch is a blunt block, not an architecture.
deprecated.severity: DANGEROUS - do not connect this tool without removing or gating it

deprecated.impl: the legacy ad-hoc deploy_* / reconstruct_* / force_* / direct_insert_* scripts
deprecated.why: CLAUDE.md BROADCAST-007 already forbids these. Listed here so the ban lives in the ownership map too, not only in prose.

read_sap_live.note: P01 is READ-ONLY via RFC/SNC. sap_mcp_server.read_sap_table wraps the same path and would be equivalent once connected; it is not a conflict, it is the same owner with a nicer surface.

read_abap_source.authoritative: the extracted corpora in git - extracted_code/ (1283), extracted_sap_p01/ (175), extracted_sap/ (225) - indexed by brain_v2/code_inventory.json and code_sections.json
read_abap_source.note: Live ADT reads (adt_read_source, get_abap_source) are for objects NOT yet in the corpus, and anything they fetch belongs in the corpus afterwards (feedback_downloaded_code_goes_to_golden_corpus).

recurring_verification.authoritative: Zagentexecution/quality_checks/run_all.py (discovers Zagentexecution/quality_checks/*.py by glob; run by rebuild_all.py Step 3e)
recurring_verification.note: Deliberately NOT a registry - a central list is a list someone forgets to update. An undeclared script is reported UNCLASSIFIED and fails loudly.

promote_knowledge_at_close.authoritative: the MAIN agent, per the project rule that the main agent executes and does not delegate the protocol
promote_knowledge_at_close.note: The brain-steward subagent is a prompt template and a mechanisation aid, NOT the owner. stop_steward_hook.py cannot invoke it - it prints a request. Whether anything ran is now recorded by brain_v2/agent_trace_hook.py.

mcp_server_whole.authoritative: none - the MCP server is NOT part of the current architecture
mcp_server_whole.status: DEPRECATED s099. No .mcp.json, `mcp` package absent, 16 tools never invoked.

deprecated.why: Connecting it would resurrect brain_search reading a DIFFERENT brain source than graph_queries, and adt_deploy writing to D01 with none of the gates built after INC-CLASS-LOSS. Reviving an unrun parallel layer adds conflict, not capability.

_the_decision_s099: The architecture that WORKS today is: Python scripts + the graph_queries CLI + 4 hooks + quality_checks discovered by glob. That layer ran mechanically all session, unattended. The MCP server is a parallel universe that NEVER RAN - no .mcp.json, its dependency not installed, 16 tools nobody ever called. JP: 'no tomar algo viejo y enchufarlo'. So it is NOT connected. It is deprecated whole. Where it had a genuinely better idea - golden reads carrying provenance and freshness instead of 15 ad-hoc sqlite3 snippets - the IDEA is ported into the working layer, not the code.
